_about: IN625 (LPBF, AM-Bench) constitutive and thermal data used by the thermo-mechanical AM-Bench 2018 model. Values transcribed from the primary NIST files (downloaded 2026-11-06) and the baseline property table of the user's data guide (Denlinger-Michaleris DED IN625 set). Temperatures in degC, stresses in MPa.

macto.source: NIST CHAL-AMB2022-04-MaCTO, doi:10.18434/mds2-2681, file 'CHAL-AMB2022-04-MaCTO submission ANSWERS.xlsx' (Sheet1) and 'AMB2022-04-MaCTO_calibration_data.xlsx' (Summary)
macto.specimens: compression cylinders (D 2.8 x H 4.37 mm) machined from the AMB2018-01 IN625 bridge build (calibration file note: 'produced from the Inconel 625 NIST AMB2018-01 sample'); BD = loading along the build direction, TD = transverse (in-plane)
macto.quantity: true compressive flow stress (magnitude) at given true strains (magnitude), after machine-compliance correction; first value is the 0.2 % offset yield strength

matto.source: NIST CHAL-AMB2022-04-MaTTO, doi:10.18434/mds2-2588, 'prediction ANSWERS CHAL-AMB2022-04-MaTTO.xlsx' (mean +- 1 sd, n = 12)
matto.note: mini-tensile specimens from AMB2022 LPBF IN625 blocks (not the AMB2018-01 bridge build); true stress / true strain

e8.source: NIST AMB2022 ASTM E8 tension, doi:10.18434/mds2-2760, SpecimenT3..T7_stress_strain.csv (engineering, DIC 25.4 mm virtual extensometer); reduced by benchmarks/literature/in625_material.py
e8.note: as-built IN625, AMB2022-625-CBM-B1 build (EOS M270, 195 W, 800 mm/s, 20 um, X-Y alternating), room temperature

baseline_table.source: temperature-dependent IN625 set of the Abaqus AM thermo-mechanical example after Denlinger & Michaleris (DED), as listed in the user's data guide (sec. 2.1); alpha used as MEAN coefficient referred to 20 C (Abaqus *EXPANSION convention) -- to be verified against the original source
baseline_table.poisson_note: 0.278 = value used by the AM-Bench measurement teams to convert strains (and the wrought IN625 room-temperature value); 0.366 of the DED baseline kept as a sensitivity option

process_ambench2018.source: Heigel et al., J. Res. NIST 125 (2020) 125005, doi:10.6028/jres.125.005, Sec. 3.2-3.4 and Table 2
process_ambench2018.scan_rotation: infill parallel to x on odd layers and to y on even layers
process_ambench2018.substrate: IN625, 100 x 100 x 12.7 mm, bolted with four 1/4-20 cap screws
process_ambench2018.plate_temperature: not stated in the paper; 20 C assumed

cyclic_concli2024.source: Concli et al., Prog. Addit. Manuf. (2024), doi:10.1007/s40964-023-00545-1 (as-built LPBF IN625, EOS M290, R = -1, 0.1 Hz, 5 LCF specimens)
cyclic_concli2024.note: literature values from the data guide; not used by the residual-stress model
